wiki-ingest.template: Run the wiki-ingest skill. Ingest the following sources into the Obsidian wiki vault: $ARGUMENTS. Follow the skill instructions for extract, resolve, and schema steps. Update .manifest.json, index.md, log.md, and hot.md after completing.
wiki-ingest.description: Ingest documents into the wiki vault

wiki-update.template: Run the wiki-update skill. Scan the current project, identify what's worth keeping (architecture decisions, patterns, trade-offs, not code listings), and sync it into the Obsidian vault. Check .manifest.json for last_commit_synced and only process the delta since then.
wiki-update.description: Sync current project knowledge into the wiki

wiki-query.template: Run the wiki-query skill. Answer the following question using the Obsidian wiki vault: $ARGUMENTS. Use tiered retrieval: scan titles, tags, and summaries first; only open page bodies if the index pass can't answer. Return a synthesized answer with [[wikilink]] citations.

wiki-status.template: Run the wiki-status skill. Show what's been ingested, what's pending, and the current delta. Also analyze vault shape: top hubs, bridge pages, tag cluster cohesion, and suggested questions the wiki can answer.
wiki-status.description: Show wiki ingestion status and insights

wiki-lint.template: Run the wiki-lint skill. Audit the Obsidian vault for orphaned pages, broken wikilinks, stale content, contradictions, and missing frontmatter. Report a dashboard of wiki health issues.
wiki-lint.description: Audit wiki health and find issues

cross-linker.template: Run the cross-linker skill. Scan the vault for unlinked mentions of existing pages and weave them into the knowledge graph with [[wikilinks]]. Reduce orphan pages and strengthen connections.

wiki-rebuild.template: Run the wiki-rebuild skill. Ask the user whether to archive the current wiki (timestamped snapshot), rebuild from scratch using .manifest.json sources, or restore a previous archive. Proceed based on their choice.
wiki-rebuild.description: Archive, rebuild, or restore the wiki

wiki-capture.template: Run the wiki-capture skill. Save the current conversation as a wiki note. Distill the key concepts, decisions, and takeaways into a properly formatted markdown page in the vault with correct frontmatter.
wiki-capture.description: Save current conversation as wiki note
